beats.care: Applying? Upload clear, correct age and address proof. An official says applications get rejected when documents aren't proper.
beats.what: Hyderabad district has received 4.13 lakh Form 6 applications for new voter IDs, the most in Telangana, says the Chief Electoral Officer's office.
beats.why: First-time voters and people whose names were dropped during the ongoing SIR are applying. So far 2.04 lakh are approved and 73,868 rejected.

cards.body: About 4.29 lakh have been approved so far, and 3.8 lakh are still pending.
cards.caption: Form 6 applications across Telangana

cards.body: Rangareddy got 1.59 lakh applications and Medchal-Malkajgiri 1.15 lakh, both behind Hyderabad. Overseas Indians filed 8,100 Form 6A applications, but only 1,059 have been approved.
It's the form to register as a new voter, or to get back on the list if your name was dropped. You can file it online on the Election Commission's voter portal or through your booth level officer.
